objective: Develop a learned pixel segmentation extension of Adobe TrustMark, without copying box predictions or coding image-specific rules.
initialization: Official trustmark_bbox_Q.ckpt ResNet50 and feature pyramid, loaded strictly with checksum verification.
learned_extension: Fine-tune the feature pyramid and train new multiscale projections, an image-residual branch and a dense 128x128 mask head. Frozen ResNet and batch-norm statistics limit the number of adapted parameters.
input: RGB image, provided-decoder message agreement maps, known watermark method; no image identifier or test label enters the model.
excluded: No Adobe output boxes, fixed rectangle blend, spatial mask templates, per-image rules or public-leaderboard-driven fitting.
loss: Binary cross entropy plus mean foreground/background soft Dice loss
augmentation: Joint random right-angle rotations and horizontal reflection of image, guidance and training mask
validation: Same five folds and seeds as the incumbent: each has 324 fit, 84 inner tuning and 102 outer validation images. Checkpoint and threshold decisions use inner tuning only.
promotion: Compare against cv_pretrained_v1. Require mean OOF gain >= 0.002, positive gain in every fold, and paired conditional bootstrap 99% lower bound > 0.
limitations: Architecture development reuses this small labeled dataset. OOF evaluation is a development check, not an untouched final test; hidden organizer evaluation remains independent.
